pairs: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen:
And the Lord said to Moses:
Adhuc una plaga tangam Pharaonem et Ægyptum,
“I will touch Pharaoh and Egypt with one more plague,
et post hæc dimittet vos,
and after these things he will release you,
et exire compellet.
and he will compel you to go out.
Dices ergo omni plebi ut postulet vir ab amico suo,
Therefore, you will tell all the people to ask, a man of his friend,
et mulier a vicina sua,
and a woman of her neighbor,
vasa argentea et aurea.
for vessels of silver and of gold.
Dabit autem Dominus gratiam populo suo coram Ægyptiis.
Then the Lord will grant favor to his people in the sight of the Egyptians.”
Fuitque Moyses vir magnus valde in terra Ægypti coram servis Pharaonis
And Moses was a very great man in the land of Egypt,
et omni populo.
in the sight of the servants of Pharaoh and of all the people.
Et ait:
And he said:
Hæc dicit Dominus:
“Thus says the Lord:
Media nocte egrediar in Ægyptum:
‘In the middle of the night I will enter into Egypt.
et morietur omne primogenitum in terra Ægyptiorum,
And every firstborn in the land of the Egyptians shall die,
a primogenito Pharaonis,
from the firstborn of Pharaoh,
qui sedet in solio ejus,
who sits on his throne,
usque ad primogenitum ancillæ quæ est ad molam,
even to the firstborn of the handmaid, who is at the millstone,
et omnia primogenita jumentorum.
and all the firstborn of the beasts of burden.
Eritque clamor magnus in universa terra Ægypti,
And there will be a great outcry throughout the entire land of Egypt,
qualis nec ante fuit,
such as has not been before,
nec postea futurus est.
nor ever will be afterward.
Apud omnes autem filios Israël non mutiet canis ab homine usque ad pecus:
But among all the sons of Israel there shall not be even a mutter from a dog, from man, even to cattle,
ut sciatis quanto miraculo dividat Dominus Ægyptios et Israël.
so that you may know how miraculously the Lord divides the Egyptians from Israel.’
Descendentque omnes servi tui isti ad me,
And all these, your servants,
et adorabunt me, dicentes:
shall descend to me and shall reverence me,
Egredere tu,
by saying: ‘Depart,
et omnis populus qui subjectus est tibi:
you and all the people who are subject to you.’
post hæc egrediemur.
After these things, we will depart.”
Et exivit a Pharaone iratus nimis.
And he went out from Pharaoh exceedingly angry.
Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen:
Then the Lord said to Moses:
Non audiet vos Pharao ut multa signa fiant in terra Ægypti.
“Pharaoh will not listen to you, so that many signs may be accomplished in the land of Egypt.”
Moyses autem et Aaron fecerunt omnia ostenta,
Now Moses
quæ scripta sunt,
and Aaron did all the wonders that are written,
coram Pharaone.
in the sight of Pharaoh.
Et induravit Dominus cor Pharaonis,
And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh;
nec dimisit filios Israël de terra sua.
neither did he release the sons of Israel from his land.
